fee_notes: Royalty 5% of Gross Sales, debited weekly. Marketing Fee currently 4%, capped at 5% max (increases ≤0.5%/year). Technology Fee $100–$400/month. POS Systems Fee $230–$340/terminal/month. Music Fee $40–$50/month. No disclosed royalty or marketing floor minimums.
raw_excerpt: Royalty 5% of Gross Sales based on the prior week's Gross Sales. Marketing Fee Currently 4% of Gross Sales. Technology Fee Currently ranges from $100-$400 (plus applicable taxes) per month. POS Systems Fee Currently ranges from $230 to $340 (plus applicable taxes) per terminal per month.
